text:
Alana: Heads-up — planning to enable the new per-tenant config gate for the routing optimizer tonight during the 22:00-23:00 quiet window. Can someone take the flip and own rollback?
Mike S: I can take the flip. What % are we opening to first? :eyes:
Alana: Start at 5% for 10m, then 25% for 10m if metrics look good, then full. Safe-defaults must remain on for all unknown-models.
Sophie R: Quick Q — do we have a smoke checklist? I can run quick tests from EU and US after flip.
Alana: Yep — core checks: 1) p50/p95 latency on inference < 200ms delta, 2) error rate < 0.5% on routing svc, 3) no increase in 5xx from model-runner, 4) KV-prefix cache hit rate not dropping >5pp.
Alana: I'll paste commands in a sec.
Mike S: I have pager coverage until 23:30. Javi can take followups after.
Javi C: happy to own rollback if needed. Do we have a kill-switch config?
Alana: Kill-switch is the flag 'routing_optimizer:enabled' in config-store. Rollback is a single toggle to false, and we also have a route fallback to model-v1 pinned for any tenant that errors.
Alana: Smoke commands:
```
# health checks
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.prod/health || echo "health-fail"
rctl metric tail routing-svc request_count,5xx_rate --since 5m
rctl feature get routing_optimizer:enabled --env prod
```
Mike S: I'll run the above then do a couple of sample requests: `curl -H \"X-Tenant: test-eu\" https://api.redwood.prod/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'`
Sophie R: I'll run EU smoke from my laptop at +6 and +16 after flip. Will report latency + error delta.
deploy-bot: scheduled action created — toggle routing_optimizer:enabled -> true at 2026-03-18T22:05:00Z (quiet window). Owner: Mike S.
Alana: Timing updated: flip at 22:05, start at 5% for 10m. If any check fails, rollback immediately and call the channel.
Mike S: Acknowledged. I will post time-of-flip and first metrics.
Sophie R: FYI, I'll also watch ModelRunner logs for increased OOM or slowdowns.
Javi C: If rollback happens, I'll set the flag to false and re-pin routes: `rctl route pin --model model-v1 --all-tenants`
Alana: Good. Two more notes: 1) Notify support if any customer tickets come in, 2) keep safe-defaults ON for unknown models (do not flip that).
Mike S: flipping in 5.
Mike S: flip done @1769995450 — routing_optimizer enabled = true at 5%
Mike S: first 10m metrics: p50 +8ms, p95 +24ms, 5xx_rate steady 0.12% -> looks good :thumbsup:
Sophie R: EU check +6m: latency +10ms, no 5xx. Logging normal.
deploy-bot: audit log entry created for toggle by Mike S at 1769995460.
Alana: OK moving to 25% in 2m. Mike, Sophie, Javi — be on call for next 15m.
Mike S: moving to 25% now.
Mike S: 25% steady at +12m, no regressions. Proceeding to full ramp.
Sophie R: running final smoke now. All good from EU.
Javi C: prepared rollback commands in case, nothing needed.
Mike S: full ramp complete at 1769995590. No rollback needed. I’ll close handoff to Javi.
Alana: Thanks team. Will update rollout doc and close the ticket. :tada:
